title: Jujutsu Kaisen Creator Shares Surprising Yuji Crossover With Iconic Musician
content: Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s creator has returned with an unexpected crossover for Yuji Itadori with some new art shared with an iconic musician. Jujutsu Kaisen might have ended its original manga run with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine back in 2024, but the franchise has been active with all sorts of new projects ever…

title: Nearly 15 Years Later, Hunter x Hunter Finally Brings Back Its Biggest Stars
content: Hunter x Hunter is back in action this Summer with new chapters after a two year long hiatus , and the newest chapter of the series has finally brought back Gon and Killua nearly 15 years since they were last seen together.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Hidden Gem Action Anime Confirms Return With Season 3 Release Window
content: A hidden gem action anime series that you can now find streaming on Crunchyroll has finally confirmed when it’s coming back for Season 3 of its run next year. There are so many anime franchises that hit our screens each year that it can be hard to watch everything that you wanted to keep an eye out for.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump Confirms Date for Major Updates on 2027 Anime Releases
content: Shonen Jump fans are in for some big updates soon enough as Shueisha has revealed when they’re going to reveal news for many of their projects now in the works for a launch in 2027 and beyond.
author: ComicBook

title: Luffy and Zoro Arrive to Free Loki in One Piece Episode 1171 Preview
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1171, showing Luffy and Zoro about to free Loki from his chains. The two Straw Hats had to face Scopper Gaban in order to acquire the key in the previous episode/ The anime returned after a 3-month break on April 5, with the crew reaching the giants’ Elbaph Island.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kino's Journey, Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online's Keiichi Sigsawa Writes 1st Original Manga
content: Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic online magazine launched a new manga by writer Keiichi Sigsawa ( Kino's Journey ) and artist Hayato Asaki titled Kemono-tachi no Peregrinatio ( Peregrinatio Bestiarum or The Beasts' Wandering), on Friday. This is the first original manga written by Sigsawa.
author: ANN

title: Rudy Learns King-Class Water Magic in Mushoku Tensei Episode 4 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 4 preview images and synopsis ahead of its July 19 premiere. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .
author: Anime Corner

title: Web Manga 'Real mo Tama ni wa Uso wo Tsuku' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Manga author Niichi announced on their official X account on Sunday that their Real mo Tama ni wa Uso wo Tsuku ( Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie! ) web manga is receiving a television anime adaptation. Niichi drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured). The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie Gets Anime Adaptation
content: Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie manga series by Niichi is getting an anime adaptation, set to release in 2027. Two commemorative illustrations by the manga creator were also released: The manga was originally serialized on Niichi’s X (formerly Twitter) account since 2018.
author: Anime Corner
